verdict.rationale: Beamer's core product is a changelog-as-a-service app. Its documentation describes announcing new features and product updates, with notifications, visuals, AI-assisted post creation, and user comments and reactions to close the feedback loop. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the publishing workflow.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can publish a changelog announcing shipped features to close the loop with customers

citations.quote: Announce your latest product changes, new features, bug fixes, news and more with Beamer’s changelog as a service app
Create [notifications](/in-app-notification-center) for your new features or product updates.
Collect user comments and reactions to see what people really think of your latest product updates.
Integrate with your favorite support apps to close the feedback loop.
Create clear, on-brand changelog posts in seconds with AI.
